title: 2023年9月8号楼北门牛形金属标、门楣店名及回墙招牌
date_scope: 当代商用外装，以2023年9月的两站照片为准。
measurements: Native upper-left image origin. XY plane fit from the two recorded north cameras. Metric rings use local horizontal coordinate (−Y on north-facing signs or +X on the brick return) and Z. Plaque plane Y=5.98. Primitive return wall Y=6.045. Outline of each line sampled from original photo. Fine lettering and copper patina have photographic uncertainty. Studs and the unseen thickness of metal letters are estimated.
